key_insight: Random splits reward recipe memorisation, while provenance-grouped evaluation reveals which models generalise to unseen perovskite solar-cell research.
engineering_relevance: More rigorous evaluation can help engineers choose models for new device recipes and fabrication settings rather than familiar historical examples.
method: Map institutional provenance in the Perovskite Database.
Apply grouped splits that progressively isolate duplicate devices, publications and institutions.
Benchmark 13 models and analyse feature importance.
evidence_signal: Nearly two-thirds of curated devices share an exact recipe; tree ensembles lead on random splits, but composition-aware neural architectures excel on unseen institutions and future discoveries.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical performance metrics, so the size and uncertainty of generalisation gains require checking in the full paper.
paper_title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
